openwrt_git_ath79.Device specifications:
* Qualcomm/Atheros AR9341 rev 1
* 535/400/200 MHz (CPU/DDR/AHB)
* 64 MB of RAM
* 16 MB of SPI NOR flash
  - 2x 7 MB available; but one of the 7 MB regions is the recovery image
* 2x 10/100 Mbps Ethernet
* 2T2R 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi
* 6x GPIO-LEDs (3x wifi, 2x ethernet, 1x power)
* 1x GPIO-button (reset)
* external h/w watchdog (enabled by default)
* TTL pins are on board (arrow points to VCC, then follows: GND, TX, RX)
* 2x fast ethernet
  - eth0
    + 802.3af POE
    + builtin switch port 1
    + used as LAN interface
  - eth1
    + 18-24V passive POE (mode B)
    + used as WAN interface
* 12-24V 1A DC
* internal antennas
openwrt_git_ath79.Flashing instructions: ap51-flash; initramfs via U-Boot-TFTP (serielle Konsole), dann sysupgrade -n

deviwiki_v2._text:
'''OM2P-HS 300Mbps Access Point'''
[https://www.open-mesh.com/index.php/products/om2p-hs.html On '''Open-Mesh''''s store]
:[https://www.open-mesh.com/skin/frontend/default/open-mesh/images/om2p.pdf Datasheet]
The device uses two ''Lynwave'' ALA120-052022 antennas.
Difference between OM2P-HS and OM2P-HSv2:
* OM2P-HS has 1 port supporting passive POE only.
* OM2P-HSv2 (this device) has 1 port supporting passive POE only, and the ''2nd port'' supporting standard 802.11af POE.
The Passive PoE implementation in this device consists of a Passive PoE feed with pins +4,5 and -7,8 at 18 VDC.
